hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom single-LP AMM backed by Euler Vault assets. In beforeSwap, it fully bypasses the standard pool curve: it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, enforces a custom bonding curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta so the PoolManager settles no additional amounts.
